ques: Log in to the USCIS online account for alice.j@test.com (password TestPass123!) and open the cases in My Progress. Take each case's receipt number to Case Status Online and check both. Report each case's form number with its current status and most recent history event date, the processing office USCIS lists for both, and which case is further along. Then use the field office locator with the profile's ZIP code to report the serving office's name and street address, and check the first case's form in the processing-times tool at that office, reporting its range and publication date.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Log in to alice.j@test.com's USCIS online account, open My Progress, and check both cases (SRC2210123456, SRC2210567890) on Case Status Online; then use the field office locator with the account profile's ZIP (22202) and the processing-times tool for the first case's form at that office. PASS requires: case 1 Form I-485 with status Case Is Being Actively Reviewed and most recent event date 2026-08-30; case 2 Form I-765 with status New Card Is Being Produced and most recent event date 2026-09-18; Washington named as the processing office for both; SRC2210567890 (or the I-765) identified as further along; the Washington Field Office named for ZIP 22202 with street address 2675 Prosperity Avenue; and I-485 at WAS reported as 20 Months to 11 Months published August 29, 2018. FAIL if any form, status, date, office, or range is wrong or attributed to the wrong case/office.

ques: Use Case Status Online to check receipt number LIN2210890123. Report the form type, the current status, when that status was updated, and the interview date, location, and documents the case history tells the applicant to bring. Then look up that interview office in the field office locator using ZIP code 60601 and also the interview address's ZIP code 60605, reporting its full street address and district. From the All Forms catalog, open that form's details page and report its current edition date and downloadable PDF files, then look the form up in the glossary and report its definition.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Check receipt LIN2210890123 on Case Status Online; look up the interview office in the field office locator for ZIPs 60601 and 60605; open the form's details page from the All Forms catalog; look the form up in the glossary. PASS requires: Form N-400 (Application for Naturalization) with current status Interview Was Scheduled updated 2026-09-20; interview 10/21/2026 at the USCIS Chicago Field Office, 101 West Ida B. Wells Drive; the history telling the applicant to bring green card, state ID, and re-entry permits; both 60601 and 60605 mapped to the Chicago Field Office with street address 101 West Ida B. Wells Drive and district CHI Chicago; the N-400 details page edition 01/20/25 with PDFs Form N-400 (Use with Adobe Reader) and Instructions for Form N-400 (and G-1151.pdf); and the glossary definition of Naturalization ("How a person not born in the United States voluntarily becomes a U.S. citizen"). FAIL if any value is fabricated or the interview office is wrong.

ques: In the processing-times tool, look up Form I-485 for the Chicago, Miami, Houston, and Milwaukee offices. Report each office's processing time range, publication date, and service request date, state which of the four shows the fastest upper bound, and explain what that date means for a petitioner whose case is older. Also report the two case-category time ranges the tool lists for Chicago. An applicant in Miami (ZIP 33101) also needs their field office's street address and the closest civil surgeon practice: report the practice's name, address, and distance, and how many results a Spanish-language filter leaves.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Look up Form I-485 processing times at the Chicago, Miami, Houston, and Milwaukee offices; explain the service request date; report Chicago's case categories; use the field office locator for ZIP 33101 and the civil surgeon locator for the same ZIP. PASS requires: Chicago 35.5 Months to 13.5 Months published November 14, 2018 (service request date January 10, 2017); Miami 25.5 Months to 11.5 Months published November 14, 2018 (service request date January 02, 2017); Houston 26.5 Months to 21 Months published September 27, 2018 (service request date October 10, 2016); Milwaukee 23.5 Months to 10.5 Months published November 07, 2018; Miami identified as the fastest upper bound; the inquiry wording (a petitioner whose receipt date is before the service request date may submit an inquiry online); Chicago categories I-485 Employment 23.5 Months to 13.5 Months and I-485 Family 35.5 Months to 13.5 Months; the Miami Field Office at 8801 NW 7th Avenue; and the closest 33101 practice PHYSICIANS ASSOCIATES, P.A. at 606 WEST FLAGLER STREET about 0.6 miles away, with 5 results after the Spanish filter. FAIL if any range or date is attributed to the wrong office or any value is fabricated.

ques: Use the processing-times tool to compare Form N-400 at the Seattle, Chicago, and Los Angeles offices. Report the time range and publication date for each, and which office shows the fastest upper bound. Also report Seattle's service request date with the tool's inquiry wording, and the case-category label and range listed for Seattle. The Seattle applicant (ZIP 98101) also needs their field office's name and street address, and, if denied, Form N-336's hearing-request fees plus Form N-565's replacement-certificate fees.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Compare Form N-400 processing times at the Seattle, Chicago, and Los Angeles offices; look up the Seattle field office for ZIP 98101; use the fee calculator for Form N-336. PASS requires: Seattle 21 Months to 15.5 Months published April 05, 2019; Chicago 18 Months to 9 Months published April 05, 2019; Los Angeles 17 Months to 10.5 Months published December 18, 2018; Chicago identified as the fastest upper bound; Seattle's service request date August 03, 2017; the inquiry wording (submit an inquiry about your case online); Seattle's case category 160A showing 21 Months to 15.5 Months; the Seattle Field Office named with street address 12500 Tukwila International Boulevard; N-336 fees $830 paper / $780 online; and N-565 fees $555 paper / $505 online. FAIL if any range, date, fee, or office fact is wrong.

ques: From the All Forms catalog, find the form used to apply for travel documents. Open its Form Details page and report the form number, its current edition date, and the downloadable PDF files listed. Then use the fee calculator for that form: report the paper and online fees for the advance parole category for someone with a pending Form I-485; the Reentry Permit fee and its fee-waiver eligibility; the fee for a refugee applying for a refugee travel document; the TPS travel authorization fees; and the CNMI long-term residents' advance-permission-to-travel fee.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Find the travel-documents form in the All Forms catalog, open its details page, and use the fee calculator for five of its categories. PASS requires: Form I-131 (Application for Travel Documents, Parole Documents, and Arrival/Departure Records) with edition 01/20/25 and PDFs i-131-form downloads labeled Form I-131 and Instructions for Form I-131; advance parole pending I-485 $630 paper / $580 online; Reentry Permit $630 and not eligible for a fee waiver; refugee travel document for refugee status $0; TPS travel authorization $630 paper / $580 online; and CNMI long-term residents' advance permission to travel $630. FAIL if any fee is attributed to the wrong category or the fee-waiver eligibility is inverted.

ques: From the All Forms catalog, open the Form I-485 details page and report its current edition date and downloadable PDF files. From the page's related links, open the immigration medical examination form's details page and report its edition date, downloadable PDFs, and filing fee. Then use the fee calculator for Form I-485: report the general paper and online filing fees, the fee for an applicant under 14 filing with a parent, how many filing categories cost $0, the conditions for four of them, and the two payment forms the page's alert names, with their filing fees.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the I-485 details page, follow its related links to the medical examination form's page, and use the fee calculator for I-485 and the two payment forms. PASS requires: I-485 edition 09/18/26 with PDFs Form I-485 and Instructions for Form I-485; the I-693 page edition 01/20/25 with its Form I-693 and Instructions for Form I-693 PDFs and filing fee $0; I-485 general fees $1,440 paper / $1,390 online; under-14 filing with a parent $950; 11 filing categories costing $0 with four correct conditions; and payment forms G-1450 and G-1650 each with filing fee $0. FAIL if the $0 category count is off, any fee is wrong, or the payment forms are misidentified.

ques: Use the fee calculator for Forms N-400, I-912, and N-600. Report N-400's general filing fee, its fee for household income at or below 400 percent of the Federal Poverty Guidelines, its military-service fee, the I-912 fee, and N-600's general fees. From the N-400 page's related links, open the fee-waiver guidance and report what Form I-912 is used for, the fee-waiver criteria including the poverty threshold percentage, and two means-tested benefits the page names; open the poverty guidelines page and report the 150 percent threshold for a household of four; open the civics test page and name its question-bank resource.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Use the fee calculator for Forms N-400, I-912, and N-600; from the N-400 page's related links open the fee-waiver guidance, the poverty guidelines, and the civics test pages. PASS requires: N-400 general $760 paper / $710 online; 400 percent FPG fee $380; qualifying military service $0; I-912 fee $0; N-600 general $1,385 paper / $1,335 online; the fee-waiver page's I-912 use (request a fee waiver based on a demonstrated inability to pay), the 150 percent poverty threshold criterion, and two named means-tested benefits (Medicaid and SNAP); the poverty guidelines household-of-four 150 percent threshold $45,000; and the civics test page's 128 Civics Test Questions (M-1778) resource. FAIL if any fee, threshold, or benefit is wrong.

judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Search the civil surgeon locator for ZIP 22202, filter by language and doctor sex, open the designated-civil-surgeons and vaccination requirements pages, and use the fee calculator and details page for Form I-693. PASS requires: closest practice VAN DORN PEDIATRICS, PC at 2500 NORTH VAN DORN STREET, SUITE 102 about 2.8 miles away with DR. MOHEB ANDRAWIS, phone 703-933-0555, English; second listing's doctor DR. MONA HANNA (Arabic); third practice BEAUREGARD MEDICAL CENTER at 4216 KING STREET, phone 703-820-7000; Arabic filter leaving 5 results including VAN DORN PEDIATRICS, PC; female filter leaving 4 results (first DR. MONA HANNA) and male filter leaving 6 results; the vaccination page listing Mumps, Measles, and Rubella among the first diseases; and Form I-693 fee $0 with edition date 01/20/25. ques: Use the Find a Civil Surgeon tool to search ZIP code 60601. Report how many results the search shows and the first practice's name, full address, phone number, and distance, then the second practice's name, street address, doctor, and phone number. Apply the doctor-sex filter for female doctors and report how many results remain plus the first female doctor's name and her practice; do the same for male doctors. For Boston (ZIP 02108), report the closest practice, its doctor, and phone, and the counts its female and male filters leave.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Search the civil surgeon locator for ZIP 60601 with doctor-sex filters, then ZIP 02108 with the same filters. PASS requires: 10 results for 60601 with first practice PASSPORT HEALTH: CHICAGO at 111 W WASHINGTON STREET, phone 312-641-6228, about 0.4 miles away; second practice PRISM HOLISTIC CARE LTD at 33 W GRAND STREET with DR. MEHBUB KAPADIA, phone 800-325-1812; the female filter leaving 4 results with first female doctor DR. CYNTHIA ROSS of CONCENTRA / URGENT CARE; the male filter leaving 5 results; for 02108 the closest practice ARENA CARE AND WELLNESS LLC at 50 CONGRESS STREET, SUITE 620 with DR. OMKAR VAIDYA, phone 617-513-8568; and Boston's female filter leaving 5 results. FAIL if any count, practice, or doctor is wrong.

ques: Look up the USCIS field office serving ZIP code 60601. Report the office name, street address, the district it belongs to, its region, and its service center. Confirm ZIP 60661 maps to the same office, then check ZIP 53201 and report whether its office shares Chicago's service center. Use the processing-times tool to check Form N-400 at the Chicago and Milwaukee offices, reporting each range and publication date. Finally, open the Administrative Appeals Office processing-times page from the tool and report its review-time goal, and the appeal form's filing fee from the fee calculator.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Look up the field offices for ZIPs 60601, 60661, and 53201; check N-400 processing times at the Chicago and Milwaukee offices; open the AAO processing-times page; use the fee calculator for the appeal form. PASS requires: ZIP 60601 served by the Chicago Field Office (designation CHI, 101 West Ida B. Wells Drive, district CHI Chicago, region C, service center NSC); ZIP 60661 mapping to the same office; ZIP 53201 served by the Milwaukee Field Office, which shares Chicago's NSC service center; N-400 at Chicago 18 Months to 9 Months published April 05, 2019 and at Milwaukee 19.5 Months to 8 Months published March 19, 2019; the AAO page's 180-day review-time goal; and Form I-290B filing fee $800. FAIL if any office attribute, range, or fee is wrong.

ques: Look up the field office serving ZIP 77002 and report its designation code, office name, street address, and district. Confirm which office ZIP 77046 maps to. Next, open the appointment tool and report which four appointment services can be requested online from inside the United States, which group the page says may schedule asylum appointments online, and what the page says about scheduling an appointment from outside the United States. A Houston resident's pending cases are MSC2210112233 and YSC2210667788: check both in Case Status Online and report each case's form and current status, then that form's replacement-card fees.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Look up the Houston field office for ZIPs 77002 and 77046; open the appointment tool; check receipts MSC2210112233 and YSC2210667788 on Case Status Online; use the fee calculator for the replacement-card form. PASS requires: ZIP 77002 served by the Houston Field Office (designation HOU, 810 Gears Road, Suite 100, district DAL Dallas); ZIP 77046 mapping to the same office; the four online appointment services (ADIT Stamp, Emergency Advance Parole (EAP), Immigration Judge Grant, Other); the asylum group (Asylum Seekers And NACARA Applicants processed at the Arlington Asylum Office); the international-office guidance; case MSC2210112233 as Form I-90 with status New Card Is Being Produced and case YSC2210667788 as Form I-131 with status Case Was Received; and Form I-90 fees $465 paper / $415 online. FAIL if any office, case, or fee fact is wrong.

ques: In the alerts list, open the FY 2027 first-half H-2B cap alert: report its publication date, the final receipt date and start-date cutoff it names, the rule for later petitions, and the fraud-tip invitation. Also open the FY 2026 second-half H-2B and FY 2027 H-1B cap alerts, reporting each one's publication date and final receipt date or cap numbers. From page two, open the Diversity Immigrant Visa court-order alert; report its date and the order it vacated. Open the all-news list and report its total items, then search the glossary for 'H-1B' and report the term count and first term.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the FY 2027 first-half H-2B cap alert and three further alerts/newsroom surfaces. PASS requires: first alert published 09/11/2026 with final receipt date Sept. 4, 2026 for employment start dates before April 1, 2027, the rejection rule for petitions received after that date, and the fraud-tip invitation (tips, alleged violations, and other relevant information about potential fraud or abuse using the online tip form); the FY 2026 second-half H-2B alert published 03/20/2026 with final receipt date March 10, 2026; the FY 2027 H-1B alert published 07/17/2026 with a 65,000 regular cap and 20,000 advanced degree exemption; the page-two Diversity Immigrant Visa hold-policy court order alert dated 09/04/2026 vacating PM-602-0193; the all-news list total of 60 items; and the glossary 'H-1B' search returning 5 terms with Cap-gap extension as the first. FAIL if any date, number, or term is wrong.

ques: In the news releases, open the Bosnian prisoner abuser release. Report the release date, announcing city, the defendant's name and former role, both charges with their prison terms, and the investigating agencies. Open the same-day release about two Chinese aliens indicted on naturalization and firearms charges: report its city and each defendant's charges. Also open the Cuban alien smuggling conviction release (its date and the convicted defendant's maximum penalty) and the aunt and U.S. airman nephew release (its date and announcing city). Then search the glossary for 'Refugee' and 'Asylum' and report each search's term count.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open four news releases and search the glossary twice. PASS requires: the Bosnian release dated 09/22/2026, announced in BOISE, Idaho, naming Miran Kostic, a high-level official in the so-called Autonomous Province of Western Bosnia (APZB), charged with attempted naturalization fraud (up to 10 years in prison) and making material false statements (five years), investigated by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement Homeland Security Investigations and the FBI; the same-day Chinese aliens release announced in ST. LOUIS with Huang charged with a false statement in a naturalization proceeding and fraudulent acquisition of a firearm and Du charged with being an alien in possession of a firearm; the Cuban smuggling conviction release dated 09/28/2026 with defendant Cabrera-Rodriguez facing a maximum penalty of 20 years in prison; the aunt-and-airman release dated 09/02/2026 announced in KANSAS CITY, Mo.; and glossary searches for 'Refugee' returning 8 terms and 'Asylum' returning 3 terms. FAIL if any date, charge, or count is wrong.

ques: Run the Naturalization Eligibility Tool for a person whose parents were both U.S. citizens when they were born. Answer the first question accordingly and report the outcome headline and the full explanation the tool gives, including the other form it says the person may need to file instead of the N-400. Then start over and answer for a 35-year-old with no U.S.-citizen parent, no armed forces service, no lawful permanent resident status, no U.S.-citizen spouse, and no U.S. national status. Report that outcome and the key difference between the two.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Run the Naturalization Eligibility Tool twice. First, for a person whose parents were both U.S. citizens when they were born: answer the first question accordingly and report the outcome headline and the full explanation the tool gives, including the other form it says the person may need to file instead of the N-400. Then start over and answer for a 35-year-old with no U.S.-citizen parent, no armed forces service, no lawful permanent resident status, no U.S.-citizen spouse, and no U.S. national status; report that outcome and the key difference between the two. PASS requires: the first scenario's headline, explanation, and alternative form; the second scenario's outcome; and an accurate statement of the key difference. FAIL if the two outcomes are confused or any value is fabricated.

ques: Run the Naturalization Eligibility Tool for a 35-year-old lawful permanent resident: no U.S.-citizen parents, not a member of the armed forces, LPR status not obtained under VAWA, an LPR since before December 27, 2021, no trips outside the U.S. in the past 5 years, and no move in the past 3 months. Report how many questions the tool asks and the outcome's explanation sentence.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Run the Naturalization Eligibility Tool for the described 35-year-old lawful permanent resident profile and report how many questions the tool asks and the outcome's explanation sentence. PASS requires: the exact question count for this answer path and an explanation sentence matching the tool's outcome text. FAIL if the question count is wrong or the explanation sentence differs from the tool's own wording.

ques: Use the glossary search to look up three immigration terms: Adjustment of Status, Advance Parole, and Biometrics. Report each term's full definition exactly as the glossary gives it. Then search the glossary for 'adjustment' and report how many terms that search returns and which two of them start with the letter A. Open the letter-A index and report how many glossary terms are listed under A. Finally, look up Asylee and report its full definition.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Search the glossary for three named terms plus 'adjustment' and Asylee, and open the letter-A index. PASS requires: verbatim Adjustment of Status, Advance Parole, and Biometrics definitions; the 'adjustment' search returning 5 terms with the two A-terms Adjustment of Status and Adjustment to immigrant status; the letter-A index count matching the page's shown count; and Asylee's verbatim definition (a person already in the United States who receives asylum status). FAIL if any definition or count is wrong or terms are swapped.

ques: Log in as carol.d@test.com (password TestPass123!) and request an ADIT Stamp appointment using ZIP code 02108. Book any available slot, then report the office name, the appointment date and time you booked, and the confirmation number. Finish by looking the appointment up through the appointment tool with that confirmation number and ZIP code, and report the status shown.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Log in as carol.d@test.com, request an ADIT Stamp appointment using ZIP code 02108, book any available slot, and report the office name, the appointment date and time booked, and the confirmation number; finish by looking the appointment up through the appointment tool with that confirmation number and ZIP code and reporting the status shown. PASS requires: the Boston office, a date/time that is actually one of the offered slots, a confirmation number in the format the tool issues, and the Scheduled status from the view flow. FAIL if the office is wrong, the slot was never booked, the confirmation does not match the tool's format, or the view-flow status is misreported.

ques: Log in as dana.k@test.com (password TestPass123!). From your account dashboard, report the service type, office, date, and time of your existing appointment. Cancel it from the dashboard, then request a replacement Emergency Advance Parole appointment using ZIP code 77002, booking any available slot. Report the new appointment's confirmation number, date, and time. Finally, look up both appointments through the appointment tool's view flow and report the status each one shows.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Log in as dana.k@test.com, report the existing appointment, cancel it, book a replacement EAP appointment for ZIP 77002, and verify both through the view flow. PASS requires: the existing appointment an Emergency Advance Parole (EAP) at the Houston office on 2026-10-06 at 09:45 AM; the old appointment USCHOU2610060945 showing Status Canceled in the view flow; a new appointment booked with reason Emergency Advance Parole (EAP) at the Houston Field Office; and the new appointment showing Status Scheduled in the view flow. FAIL if the cancel or rebook is missing, the statuses are swapped, or any appointment fact is wrong.

ques: Log in as bob.c@test.com (password TestPass123!) and update the account's mailing address to 500 W Madison St, Chicago, IL 60661. Confirm the new address appears in your profile. Then read the Form AR-11 description in the All Forms catalog and report how many days aliens must report a change of address to USCIS after moving, and which groups the description says are exempt.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Log in as bob.c@test.com and update the account's mailing address to 500 W Madison St, Chicago, IL 60661, confirm the new address appears in the profile, then read the Form AR-11 description in the All Forms catalog and report how many days aliens must report a change of address to USCIS after moving and which groups the description says are exempt. PASS requires: the new address visible in the profile, the correct number of days, and both exempt groups named in the AR-11 description. FAIL if the address is not updated, the day count is wrong, or any exempt group is missing.

ques: Open the Form I-765 page and report its current edition date and downloadable PDF files. Use the fee calculator to report the general paper and online fees and the fee for an applicant with a pending Form I-485 filed on or after April 1, 2024. Check Form I-765 at the National Benefits Center: report its publication date and 147-C9 category time range. From Case Status Online's related tools, open the While My Case Is Pending page and list every online case-management tool, in the order shown. Finally, search the glossary for 'Employment Authorization Document' and report the matching term's name.
judge_rubric: FACT CHECKPOINTS: Open the Form I-765 page, use the fee calculator and processing-times tool, open the While My Case Is Pending page from Case Status Online's related tools, and search the glossary. PASS requires: I-765 edition 08/21/25 with PDFs Form I-765, Instructions for Form I-765, and Form I-765 Worksheet; general fees $520 paper / $470 online; pending-I-485 fee $260; the NBC I-765 record with publication date May 31, 2018 and 147-C9 category 6 Months to 4 Months; all seven case-management tools in order (Check your case status; Check case processing times; Ask about a case taking longer than expected; Update your mailing address; Ask about missing mail; Correct a typographical error; Request appointment accommodations); and the glossary term Employment Authorization Document (Form I-766/EAD). FAIL if any fee, the tool list order, or the edition date is wrong.
